api.required_identity: checkpoint_manifest.json must exactly match all frozen fields; no defaults or profile inference
api.ground_truth: Explicit optional scoped whitelist only; never merge an arbitrary source row or classifier prediction

optional.--render: Optional research-only actual detector overlay on underlying resized RGB

image.decode: PIL Image.open then convert RGB, no crop, EXIF transpose, autolevel or other enhancement
image.model_input_hash: sha256(contiguous CHW float32 bytes before internal normalization)

validation: Exact checkpoint/helper hash before helper import; exact manifest identity; strict state dict/head load; internal transform check; eval/inference_mode/FP32; finite bounded positive-area predictions; output namespace/gate agreement checks. Invalid inputs exit CLI2 without publishing a result. CUDA >=75C or telemetry failure stops the process; no hardware changes.
output_write_scope: Only under the directory containing v92_inference_adapter.py (adapter_v1); parent source files and checkpoints cannot be output targets.
